# Notification Surface Checklist: Android Media Shell

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for the lock-screen and notification-shade surface — content, privacy, progress indication, reason surfacing, and dismissal behaviour
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/shell-ipc.md](../contracts/shell-ipc.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are lock-screen content requirements completely enumerated: document title, section title, progress, transport controls — with every other candidate (body text, elapsed, remaining, rate, voice) explicitly allowed or forbidden? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for the document-title source in every case: metadata present, metadata absent (stable placeholder), and re-sourcing on engine change? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028, Spec §FR-029, Spec §SC-030]
- [x] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for every section-title re-resolution trigger (boundary crossing, resume, skip either direction, post-engine-change re-anchor) with polling explicitly forbidden? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028d]
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for the platform mechanism that makes the surface non-dismissable while playing (ongoing flag semantics) rather than only the observable intent? [Gap, Spec §FR-028e]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for the fallback when the platform or OEM permits dismissal while audio plays despite the non-dismissable requirement? [Gap, Spec §FR-028e, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for the in-application statement when notification permission is denied, given the lock-screen surface itself is unavailable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is "most recent preceding section title" reconciled with "no section title before the first heading or when no headings exist" so the two rules partition all positions without overlap? [Clarity, Consistency, Spec §FR-028, Spec §FR-028c]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the progress-indication rule unambiguous: determinate only when the total is known at session start, indeterminate for the whole session otherwise, with no mid-session determinacy switch? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028a]
- [x] CHK009 - Is "short scrolling statement of the form ..." specified with measurable properties (content fields, scrolling versus static, one-shot versus persistent)? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §FR-041]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the paused-resident notification content precisely bounded (paused state plus resume control; no elapsed, remaining, or section title asserted)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009a, Spec §SC-043]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the distinction between transient reason surfaces (auto-dismiss at 3 s) and the persistent resident surface (becomes dismissable, never auto-dismissed) explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028e]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 - Are notification-visibility requirements (app declares visible, never redacts, offers no hide-on-lock mode) consistent with the obligation to obey the phone-wide hide-contents preference? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028b, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 - Are the failure-reason persistence rules (persist indefinitely) and the focus-loss pause-reason expiry rules (expire everywhere after 3 s) stated as disjoint sets with no overlapping case? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037, Spec §FR-037a, Spec §FR-041]
- [x] CHK014 - Are dismissal rules consistent across FR-009a (residency cost), FR-010 (cold-start refusal), FR-028e (dismissal contract), and FR-032f (teardown at completion)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028e, Spec §FR-032f]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the promise "same stated reason as permanent loss" for silence-demanding interruptions consistent between User Story 2 scenario 4, FR-013a, FR-014, and FR-041? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013a, Spec §US-2]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 - Can "zero instances of document body text on any notification surface" be objectively verified, including first-sentence-as-title and quote-in-failure-reason leakage? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK017 - Can "shows title and section title rather than a generic placeholder" be objectively verified when no phone-wide redaction is enabled? [Measurability, Spec §SC-046]
- [x] CHK018 - Can "zero determinacy switches within one session" and "no estimated total presented as established" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-042]
- [x] CHK019 - Can "section title correct immediately after boundary crossing, resume, skip, and re-anchor" be objectively verified with zero stale-title instances? [Measurability, Spec §SC-047]
- [x] CHK020 - Can the dismissal contract be objectively verified per surface kind (transient dismissed within 3 s of pause; resident present-and-dismissable with working resume)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-053]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for headings changing on disk mid-session (stale title versus re-resolved title)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028, Spec §FR-028d]
      Reviewed 2026-10-05: covered. FR-028d re-resolves on the closed trigger set (boundary-cross, resume, skip either direction, post-engine/voice re-anchor) with fingerprint check on resume, forbids polling/watcher, tolerates declared staleness between triggers; edge case requires following current headings, and mid-session edit recovers to paused via FR-032d/FR-036a. Verifiable via SC-047.
- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for a position before the first heading when earlier content is absent (no forward-looking title)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-028c]
- [x] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for playback reaching document end while locked (teardown recorded as neither interruption nor failure; no paused state offered afterwards)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032f, Spec §SC-045]
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for a notification dismissed while playing on an OEM build that permits it (pause versus continued audio with no surface)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-028e]
- [x] CHK025 - Are rate-display requirements defined for both surfaces: current rate visible inside the application, never on the lock screen? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, Spec §SC-027]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 - Are notification-permission request flows explicitly out of scope (consequence stated, no prompt flow designed) and recorded as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §FR-021, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 - Are MediaSession mirror mechanics (who publishes state, active-state handling, thread ownership) left to plan without any functional requirement depending on them? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`

- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
